outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals AFC Bournemouth 1.70 vs Nottingham Forest FC 0.84, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: AFC Bournemouth at home: 2W-2D-1L, 7 scored and 4 conceded in 5 games.
Nottingham Forest FC away: 1W-2D-2L, 6 scored and 9 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.53 goals per game, away teams 1.20.
Recent league form (newest first): AFC Bournemouth WWWWL, Nottingham Forest FC WLDLL (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: AFC Bournemouth has 5 home games and Nottingham Forest FC 5 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
